review_note: Independent proof-masked source review of pinned proetale.tex L4763: A finite locally finitely presented morphism Z→X has exact pro-étale direct image on abelian sheaves, because its fibrewise covering behaviour is controlled by finite étale neighbourhoods. Both finiteness qualifications remain.
statement:
Let $f : Z \to X$ be a finite morphism of schemes which is
locally of finite presentation. Then
$f_{\proetale, *} : \textit{Ab}(Z_\proetale) \to \textit{Ab}(X_\proetale)$
is exact.
hypotheses:

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-finite}
Let $f : Z \to X$ be a finite morphism of schemes which is
locally of finite presentation. Then
$f_{\proetale, *} : \textit{Ab}(Z_\proetale) \to \textit{Ab}(X_\proetale)$
is exact.
